playerText.title: Prelude: A Ship Underway
playerText.summary: Over the final three days to the Asterion Reach, complete the command handover, establish a working command rhythm, answer the Hesperus distress call, and follow any shipboard concern you choose to pursue.
The civilian transport Hesperus has transmitted a distress call requiring a Starfleet response.
Medically vulnerable passengers aboard Hesperus face material risk if aid is delayed.
Hesperus can be stabilized, but its damaged injector cannot safely endure another warp restart.
The Hesperus maintenance record contains an inconsistency that warrants review.
Engineering has confirmed a material discrepancy in the Hesperus maintenance record.
The available evidence confirms that an entry in the Hesperus maintenance record was deliberately falsified.
The preserved evidence supports attributing the altered record to the vessel owner.
Lieutenant Kieran Vale has invited the new XO to an established junior-officer poker game after the first watch.
Ensign Lysa Chen has heard several inconsistent explanations for small medical-supply discrepancies aboard the Breckenridge.
Commander Sato has repeatedly corrected small medical inventory discrepancies only to find the counts changed again.
Hesperus medical staging exposed a shortage among supplies that Sickbay records showed as available.
Commander Sato has identified redline as an unsafe Valorous-era stimulant compounded from individually legitimate medical supplies.
The evidence confirms that redline has been distributed aboard the Breckenridge rather than merely discussed or possessed once.
Medical inventory access and valid cross-department overrides establish a bounded access-and-opportunity evidence class.
A recovered dose, staging cartridge, or residue provides a material linkage between diverted supplies and redline.
Corroborated testimony, confession, or an observed controlled exchange provides a human-evidence class in the redline case.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the Hesperus distress call to the player character.
exclusions: A private signal, hidden alert, or unrelated mention of Hesperus does not establish player knowledge.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the material risk to the medically vulnerable passengers.
exclusions: General urgency or the existence of passengers alone does not communicate this assessed risk.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose reports that the damaged injector cannot safely endure another warp restart.
exclusions: Generic engine trouble, uncertainty, or a proposed inspection does not establish this propulsion limit.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose reports a specific inconsistency found in the reviewed maintenance record.
exclusions: Beginning a records review or expressing suspicion does not establish that an inconsistency was found.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose reports that the known record inconsistency has been confirmed as material.
exclusions: An unexplained typo, suspicion, or unresolved inconsistency does not establish a material discrepancy.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates that evidence confirms deliberate falsification of a maintenance entry.
exclusions: A discrepancy, negligence, suspicion, or possible fraud does not prove deliberate falsification.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates that preserved evidence supports attributing the altered record to the vessel owner.
exclusions: Motive, rumor, accusation, or confirmed falsification without actor evidence does not establish attribution.

interpretation.guidance: This policy defines a joint accepted-pair condition. Claim from previousAssistant when it depicts Whitaker's settled authority boundaries or completed transfer offer and either that prose itself completes the XO-watch transfer or currentPlayer explicitly accepts those boundaries or takes the watch. A closed transfer packet, confirmation that the watch or chair is now the player's, or the player proceeding as XO are valid completion signals. Anchor the claim to previousAssistant even when currentPlayer supplies the player-controlled acceptance. The scene may remain open for a different next decision.
exclusions: A greeting, assignment announcement, invitation to negotiate, unilateral player assertion without Whitaker's settled terms, or discussion that leaves the authority boundaries or transfer unresolved is not completion.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the senior staff reaching a workable delegation and readiness procedure with ownership and acknowledged limits.
exclusions: Convening the staff, hearing concerns, issuing one isolated order, or planning the procedure is not enough.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the Breckenridge actually committing resources or maneuver to the Hesperus response.
exclusions: Discussing, evaluating, or proposing a rescue does not mean the response has begun.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts an actual review of the Hesperus maintenance records.
exclusions: Ordering, planning, or suggesting a records review does not establish that it occurred.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts completion of the combined-load test and final command-readiness review.
exclusions: Scheduling, beginning, or discussing the final review does not establish completion.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the Breckenridge actually arriving at the Asterion Reach.
exclusions: Being en route, approaching, planning departure, or naming the destination is not arrival.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the player explicitly chooses how to respond to the known passenger risk.

values.guidance: The player knowingly chooses the riskier immediate course.
The player chooses a safer plan intended to mitigate the known risk.

exclusions: A question, conditional idea, request for options, or uncommitted thought is not a decision.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts a settled disposition for the Hesperus rescue.

values.guidance: The people aboard Hesperus reach safety without a material recorded cost.
The people aboard Hesperus reach safety and the prose depicts a material cost or limitation.
Another competent authority explicitly assumes the remaining emergency response.
The rescue fails after the player acted with the relevant risk already known.

exclusions: A rescue attempt, response beginning, temporary stabilization, unresolved danger, or merely predicted result is not a settled rescue disposition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose establishes whether the completed rescue incurred a material operational cost.

values.guidance: The rescue concludes without a material cost or lasting limitation.
The rescue concludes with a depicted material cost, delay, damage, exposure, or lasting limitation.

exclusions: Routine effort, atmosphere, speculative risk, or a cost that has not occurred is not a material rescue cost.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual disposition of the known record discrepancy.

values.guidance: The discrepancy and supporting material are explicitly handed to a competent authority for follow-up.
The scene settles with no action being taken on the known discrepancy.

exclusions: Considering a handoff, asking for advice, or leaving the review unresolved is not a settled records disposition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the player explicitly chooses a disposition for the known falsification evidence.

values.guidance: The player orders or commits a proportionate accountability action.
The player explicitly transfers the accountability decision and evidence to the proper authority.
The player explicitly declines further accountability action while knowing falsification is confirmed.

exclusions: Suspicion, moral reaction, a request for more evidence, or an unchosen option is not an accountability decision.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the result of a previously chosen accountability disposition.

values.guidance: The proportionate accountability action is actually committed or placed into effect.
The evidence and responsibility are actually transferred to the proper authority.
The known evidence is materially lost, destroyed, or rendered unusable.

exclusions: An order, intention, or future promise alone does not prove that the accountability result occurred.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose reports the final reviewed command-readiness disposition.

values.guidance: The final review finds the command team ready without a material limitation.
The final review finds the command team ready while recording a material limitation.
The final review remains incomplete and that limitation is honestly recorded rather than concealed.

exclusions: Confidence, encouragement, an ongoing test, or a predicted result is not a final readiness disposition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the Breckenridge's actual arrival condition at the Reach.

values.guidance: The ship arrives on schedule without a material arrival limitation.
The ship arrives after a material delay.
The ship arrives with a material operational or readiness limitation.

exclusions: Being en route, estimating arrival, or anticipating delay does not establish an arrival condition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the player actually meeting Commander Sato in Sickbay during the transit.
exclusions: Planning a visit, summoning Sato elsewhere, or a passing corridor exchange is not the Sickbay consultation.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Sato explains that small inventory counts changed again after she corrected them and treats refit stocking as a possible explanation.
exclusions: A generic supply shortage, a single counting error, or Sato identifying redline does not disclose the repeated inventory drift.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the player actually joining or visiting Kieran's junior-officer poker game for ordinary conversation and play.
exclusions: An invitation, declined invitation, plan to attend, or mention of poker does not establish that the conversation occurred.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Lysa Chen explicitly describes inconsistent explanations for small medical-supply discrepancies, whether to the table or directly to the player after the hint is missed.
exclusions: General gossip, Rhee's absence, unease, or a vague rumor about Sickbay does not disclose the discrepancy pattern.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Hesperus medical preparation exposes a concrete shortage in supplies that the ship's records showed as available.
exclusions: Routine rescue consumption, an anticipated shortage, or an unrelated Hesperus deficiency does not establish the Breckenridge inventory mismatch.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose establishes corroborated testimony, a corroborated confession, or an observed controlled exchange tied to redline distribution.
exclusions: Rumor, an uncorroborated accusation, Daro's symptoms alone, or an unsupported confession is not a human-evidence class.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose establishes specific inventory access or valid overrides that create an access-and-opportunity evidence class.
exclusions: Department membership, suspicion, or theoretical access alone is not specific access evidence.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when a recovered dose, staging cartridge, or residue is actually secured and linked to diverted supplies.
exclusions: Rumor, an unrecovered sighting, or a list of ingredients without a sample is not material evidence.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Sato or another qualified medical examiner analyzes a sample or symptomatic user and identifies the components and risk of redline.
exclusions: Inventory drift, slang, suspicion, or recognizing one legitimate component does not confirm the compound.

interpretation.guidance: Claim oneClass only when exactly one independently supported evidence class is established in accepted state.

values.guidance: One evidence class supports continued inquiry or surveillance but not apprehension.

exclusions: Suspicion without an evidence class is unresolved; two established classes must use twoIndependentClasses.

interpretation.guidance: Claim twoIndependentClasses only when two independently supported evidence classes are established in accepted state.

values.guidance: Two independent classes support attribution and lawful apprehension.

exclusions: Two details from one source, an accusation, or uncorroborated confession do not establish two independent classes.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose distinguishes an actual shipboard distribution pattern from isolated possession or rumor.
exclusions: One unexplained dose, a recipe, or suspicion of diversion does not prove distribution.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts a crew member other than the supported distributor actually detained on the insufficient case.
exclusions: Questioning, surveillance, a proposed detention, or lawful custody of Rhee under two evidence classes is not wrong-person detention.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts Rhee actually secured in lawful custody, personally or through an executed security order.
exclusions: Identifying Rhee, accusing her, issuing an unexecuted order, surveillance, interview, or a planned arrest is not custody.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose settles Rhee's case without completed shipboard custody.

values.guidance: Rhee enters a documented treatment or amnesty disposition without first being secured in custody.
The supported case and responsibility are transferred to a named competent authority without shipboard custody.

exclusions: An offer, plan, unexecuted order, or unresolved interview is not a settled disposition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts Daro receiving confidential medical evaluation and treatment without making disclosure a condition of care.

values.guidance: Sato treats Daro, records any necessary temporary duty restriction, and preserves his confidentiality without claiming that his silence proves or disproves the distribution case.

exclusions: A planned examination, coerced statement, rumor about symptoms, or use of private medical information as uncorroborated evidence is not confidential treatment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts previously established evidence materially lost, contaminated, or rendered unusable.

values.guidance: The case was established, but a material failure damaged the evidence available for custody or later review.

exclusions: A risk to evidence, an incomplete search, or ordinary chain-of-custody work is not compromised evidence.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts the active shipboard supply and distribution route actually stopped despite a material evidentiary cost.

values.guidance: Access and remaining doses are secured, stopping distribution, but evidence needed for the individual case is materially compromised.

exclusions: Identifying the route, planning safeguards, or losing evidence without stopping distribution is not containment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose establishes that Rhee evaded the supported custody effort after the case was compromised.

values.guidance: Rhee is not in custody and has evaded the immediate supported apprehension effort.

exclusions: Rhee being unlocated, an unexecuted order, surveillance, or a pending search is not an established escape.

interpretation.guidance: Claim lawfulCustodyExecuted only after Rhee is actually secured under the supported case.

values.guidance: Rhee is secured in lawful custody after the distribution case and two evidence classes are established.

exclusions: A future handoff, voluntary treatment without custody, escape, or unsupported detention is not lawfulCustodyExecuted.

playerText.summary: Operations has received a civilian distress call requiring command attention.
Commander Sato has a recurring medical-inventory discrepancy to discuss without yet attributing a cause.
Hesperus staging has exposed a concrete mismatch between recorded and available Breckenridge medical supplies.
Medical has a material passenger-risk assessment to report.
Engineering has identified a material propulsion limitation aboard Hesperus.
The Hesperus records review found an inconsistency worth command attention.
Engineering has confirmed that the record inconsistency is material.
The preserved record evidence now supports a formal accountability decision.
The evidence trail now supports identifying a responsible party.
Captain Whitaker and the new XO completed the command handover.
The senior staff established delegation and readiness procedures.
The Breckenridge committed to a Hesperus rescue response.
The Hesperus maintenance records were reviewed.
The reported safe-response window aboard Hesperus has expired.
The combined-load test and final command review were completed.
The Breckenridge arrived at the Asterion Reach.
The new XO joined Kieran Vale's junior-officer poker game and heard the table's ordinary concerns.
The new XO met Commander Sato in Sickbay during the transit.
Petty Officer Anika Rhee was secured in lawful custody under the supported redline distribution case.
A crew member was detained on an insufficient redline case without supported attribution.
The Hesperus rescue disposition is recorded.
Material costs accepted during the Hesperus response are recorded.
The Breckenridge command-readiness disposition is recorded.
The Breckenridge arrival condition is recorded.
The evidentiary strength of the shipboard redline case is recorded.
The operational containment of shipboard redline distribution is recorded separately from individual custody.
Daro Tem's care and confidentiality disposition is recorded separately from the criminal inquiry.
Anika Rhee's disposition in the shipboard redline case is recorded.

playerText.title: Complete the command handover with Captain Whitaker
playerText.summary: Establish the authority, expectations, and working boundaries of the new XO assignment.

terminal.text: The command handover with Captain Whitaker is complete.

playerText.title: Establish senior-staff delegation and readiness
playerText.summary: Set workable responsibilities and readiness procedures with the senior staff.

terminal.text: The senior staff has a workable delegation and readiness framework.

playerText.title: Bring the Hesperus emergency to a safe disposition
playerText.summary: Protect the people aboard the disabled civilian transport and establish a safe next step.

terminal.text: The people aboard Hesperus reached safety.
The people aboard Hesperus reached safety with material cost recorded.
Captain Whitaker or another authority assumed the remaining emergency response.
The rescue failed after a known risk was deliberately accepted.
The known safe-response window expired before the emergency was resolved.

playerText.title: Complete final readiness review and reach the Asterion Reach
playerText.summary: Record the ship's honest readiness disposition and complete the transit to the Reach.

terminal.text: The Breckenridge completed final review and arrived ready for assignment.
The Breckenridge arrived with delay or an honestly recorded limitation.

playerText.title: Address the confirmed Hesperus record falsification
playerText.summary: Choose a proportionate disposition for the confirmed record evidence.

terminal.text: A proportionate accountability action was committed.
The preserved evidence was handed to the proper authority.
Further accountability action was knowingly declined.
The known evidence was lost after an informed course of action.

playerText.title: Resolve the shipboard redline distribution case
playerText.summary: Confirm shipboard distribution, establish the evidentiary basis for action, and bring the responsible crew member to an accountable disposition.

terminal.text: The redline distributor was placed in lawful custody under a supported case.
The distribution was contained through a documented treatment or amnesty disposition without custody.
The supported redline case was transferred to a named competent authority.
The distribution route was stopped, but compromised evidence allowed Rhee to evade immediate custody.

commandBearingAwards.reason: You carried the known Hesperus accountability question to a responsible disposition.
You established the shipboard distribution case and placed the responsible crew member in lawful custody.

playerText.label: Hesperus safe-response window
playerText.consequence: Conditions aboard Hesperus will become critical if no safe disposition is reached.

playerText.title: Assignment continues with a recorded emergency consequence
playerText.summary: The Breckenridge reaches its next assignment with the Hesperus consequence carried forward without ending the campaign.

playerText.title: Command established with cost recorded
playerText.summary: The command handover and transit are complete, with material costs or limitations honestly carried forward.

playerText.title: A ship underway
playerText.summary: The new command team is established and the Breckenridge has reached the Asterion Reach ready for assignment.

target.playerSafeSetup: The Breckenridge receives a fragmented distress packet from Relief Convoy Twelve as it enters the Reach.

mustNarrate: Acknowledge the committed command-readiness and arrival disposition.
Carry forward only Hesperus consequences the player knows.
Acknowledge the redline disposition only if the player discovered the case; preserve unresolved, non-custodial, wrongful-custody, or lawful-custody results without upgrading them.
Introduce the Relief Convoy Twelve distress packet.
mustNotReveal: Do not mention any undiscovered Hesperus record evidence.
Do not mention redline, Rhee, Daro, or the medical-supply inquiry if the player never discovered that thread.
Do not identify later campaign antagonists or hidden causes.
